package design

import . "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"

var data = Type("Data", func() {

	Attribute("id", String)
	Attribute("value", String)
	Example(map[string]any{"value": "authored"})

})
var _ = Service("svc", func() {

	Method("send", func() {

		Payload(data, func() {
			Required("id")
		})
		Result(data)
		HTTP(func() {

			POST("/send")
			Header("id:X-ID")
			Body(func() {
				Attribute("value")
				Example(map[string]any{"value": "transport"})
			})

		})

	})

})
